stem: When molten sulphur is poured into cold water, an elastic mass forms. Which structural description best fits this product?

verdicts.working: Quenching molten sulphur in cold water forms plastic sulphur, an elastic polymeric form made of long chains of sulphur atoms.

working:
Rapid cooling of molten sulphur forms plastic sulphur.
Plastic sulphur consists mainly of long chains of sulphur atoms.

Independent check: Quenching molten sulphur in cold water forms plastic sulphur, an elastic polymeric form made of long chains of sulphur atoms.
solution:
Rapid cooling of molten sulphur forms plastic sulphur.
It is an elastic polymeric form consisting mainly of long chains of sulphur atoms.
